tok22.scope: Token usage recorded on this computer. Estimates at API rates, not subscription charges.
tok22.sources: Import: Claude Code and Codex JSONL (including Codex accounts), Antigravity/Gemini gen_metadata and Hermes session_model_usage databases. OpenCode usage logs are not supported. Missing or deleted logs cannot be recovered.
tok22.method: Dates follow the computer’s local time when recorded. Antigravity dates use file modification time; Hermes uses the last usage timestamp. These two sources have approximate daily allocation. Project names are omitted for privacy.
tok22.pricingNote: History keeps the rate estimate when first recorded. Unknown models show n/a. Existing daily balances and imported logs are reconciled per provider/day; they are never added twice. Display currency follows Settings.
